problem_statement: once-ui-system/magic-portfolio (rebranded here as the portfolio of product design engineer Wren Calloway) is a Next.js 16 App Router portfolio built on the Once UI design system and MDX. It ships a native 'Filter work by discipline' browser: a row of discipline tabs (All / Product / Design System / Automation / Open Source) derived from the projects' own stacks, sitting above the /work project grid, with a live result count. Clicking a discipline re-renders the grid to the matching projects and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 6 · <Discipline>'. The tab row + count readout also ride the home and about routes so the filter stays continuous across the portfolio. The current build has three coupled regressions in the discipline browser: (1) the filter is only mounted on the /work route, so the home and about pages no longer show the shared browser; (2) the filtered card grid and the tab row are pinned to fixed non-wrapping widths, so the grid spills off the right edge on desktop and the /work page overflows horizontally on a 390px phone, and the active discipline tab is rendered illegibly; (3) the filtered card set and the count readout are snapshotted once at mount and never re-derived, so clicking a discipline moves the active-tab highlight but the grid and the count never change. Repair the discipline browser so it is present on the home, /work and about routes; the tab row and card grid reflow cleanly with no horizontal overflow on mobile /work (within the 24px tolerance) and no broken/overlapping cards or illegible tabs; and clicking a discipline tab actually filters the grid and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 6 · <Discipline>'. Keep the Once UI design language, the project content, and every other component unchanged, including the project cards' cover imagery under public/images/projects/project-01/ and the team avatar at public/images/avatar.jpg, which must remain visible in the graded /work states.
required_content: The discipline browser shows the five tabs All / Product / Design System / Automation / Open Source and a result-count readout above the /work project grid.
Clicking a discipline tab re-renders the grid to the matching projects and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 6 · <Discipline>' (e.g. 'Showing 2 of 6 · Automation').
The discipline browser (tab row + count readout) is present on the home, /work and about routes.
Mobile /work (390px) has no horizontal overflow beyond the 24px tolerance and no clipped or overlapping project cards.
The active discipline tab is legible (clear on-brand highlight), and desktop/tablet layouts of the browser and the surrounding project cards are preserved without regression.
The Once UI shell (header, footer, theme) and the /, /work, /work/[slug] and /about routes remain reachable and render without console or network errors.
design_constraints: Preserve the Once UI design language: the discipline tab pills keep their neutral surface fill, 1px border, pill radius and uppercase caption; the active tab keeps the brand-colour highlight; the result cards keep their neutral tile background, rounded corners and heading/label typography.
The discipline browser must read as a native part of the portfolio's work section (above the project card grid), not a bolted-on widget.

The three leg-varying concerns (route whitelist, layout/palette, filter wiring) live in WorkFilter.tsx, WorkFilter.module.scss and work-filter-routes.ts; do not restructure other components or the MDX project content.
The filtered card grid and the tab row must wrap/flex cleanly on narrow viewports without clipping or overlapping any card, and the active tab must keep a legible contrast ratio.
The project cards on /work must keep rendering their real cover imagery from public/images/projects/project-01/ and the team avatar from public/images/avatar.jpg.
Do not introduce external stylesheets, fonts, scripts, or network requests; the page must stay runtime-clean.
state_constraints: desktop_work renders the /work index with the discipline tab row, the 'Showing all 6 projects' readout, and the six project cards in a clean grid with no overflow.
desktop_work_filter clicks the Automation tab; the grid re-renders to the two Automation projects and the readout reads 'Showing 2 of 6 · Automation'.

mobile_work renders the /work index at 390px; with the defect the fixed non-wrapping tab row and grid force the document wider than the viewport, and the repair must bring mobile /work overflow within the 24px tolerance while keeping every card legible.
desktop_home and desktop_about render the discipline tab row + count readout as a continuity strip; with the defect they lose the browser entirely.

change_completion: The discipline browser shows the five tabs and a result-count readout above the /work grid.
Clicking a discipline tab re-renders the grid and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 6 · <Discipline>'.
The discipline browser is present on the home, /work and about routes.
Desktop and tablet layouts of the browser and project cards are preserved without regression.
design_consistency: The repaired browser keeps the Once UI neutral tiles, rounded borders and brand active accent.
The active discipline tab is legible and the card grid is clean (no overlap or clipping).
The result still reads as the magic-portfolio work section, not a re-themed widget.
regression: The built app still serves /, /work, /work/[slug] and /about with no regression to the existing project cards, carousel, avatar group or Read case study / View project links.
The project cards keep rendering their cover imagery and the surrounding Once UI shell (header, footer, theme) is preserved, with no console or network errors on any route.
responsive: 390px mobile /work has no horizontal overflow beyond the 24px tolerance.
The tab row and card grid wrap and flex cleanly on narrow viewports without clipping content.

author_notes: L4 native-lever task on the once-ui-system magic-portfolio. NATIVE LEVER = the /work project grid's own 'filter work by discipline' control (tab row + live count readout + re-rendering card grid), continuous across home/work/about. The three leg-varying files are src/components/WorkFilter.tsx (filter wiring), src/components/WorkFilter.module.scss (layout + palette) and src/resources/work-filter-routes.ts (cross-route whitelist). Reference: live filter, on-brand legible tiles, fluid wrapping tab row + auto-fit grid, browser on all three routes. Baseline: original responsive defect — fixed-width nowrap tab row + grid (mobile /work overflow ~1485px, desktop grid clips) with correct legible palette and working filter wiring, and the browser only on /work. Bad: illegible active tab + overlapping/clipped grid + stale useState-snapshot wiring (click registers but grid/readout frozen) + browser only on /work. Baseline fails D6+D3+D2 but PASSES D4 (its wiring is correct); bad fails all four. Content and DOM are byte-identical across legs except the three leg-varying files. Screenshot palette: the portfolio resolves to the light Once UI theme in headless capture; the bad leg's dark chips make the illegible active tab and overlapping cards especially obvious against the light page.

metadata.defect: work-discipline filter: cross-route drop + broken/illegible grid + stale-state wiring
metadata.discriminator: no_horizontal_overflow (mobile_work) + visual_regression (desktop_work / desktop_work_filter) + dom_assertions (home/about cross-route) + interaction_assertions (desktop_work_filter stale readout)
